law_record.title: Operation of vehicles within a roundabout (C)(1)
law_record.text: The following regulations pertain to the operation of vehicles within a roundabout: The operator of a vehicle who intends to exit a roundabout: Shall use the left lane to turn left or complete a U-turn.

activation_conditions: the subject is in a multi-lane roundabout
the subject intends to turn left or complete a U-turn
residue: 'intends to exit' is intention; the exit taken is the observable substitute
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the intended exit is shown by the exit actually taken, so the whole passage from entry to exit is needed
the left lane must be held through the circulating movement
